title: Objects-12 | Model lineage starter
description: Fictional model lineage example. Dataset, model names, metrics and conclusions are illustrative; record training changes, fine-tuning origins, discarded experiments and seed replication.

nodes.title: M0 · Small CNN baseline
nodes.summary: Fix the data split and evaluation protocol before comparing changes.
nodes.configuration: Train from scratch; SGD, 90 epochs, batch 64, initial LR 0.05.
nodes.initialization: Scratch initialization; no external pretrained weights.
nodes.notes:
Confuses visually similar classes. Keep this split fixed in every later comparison.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M1 · Learning-rate recipe
nodes.summary: Keep the architecture fixed and address early training instability.
changes: Linear warmup for the first 5 epochs
Cosine decay afterwards; other settings unchanged
nodes.configuration: M0 architecture; SGD, 90 epochs, batch 64; same data split.
nodes.initialization: Train from scratch using M0 code and data settings; no weight continuation.
nodes.notes:
More stable convergence; use as the shared baseline. Warmup and schedule changed together, so their effects are not isolated.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M2A · Mixup ablation
nodes.summary: Add one augmentation to test separation of similar classes.
changes: Keep width, epoch count and optimizer fixed
nodes.configuration: M1 recipe; Mixup alpha 0.2; unchanged validation set.
nodes.initialization: Scratch training; M1 is the configuration baseline.
nodes.notes:
Illustrative macro-F1 improves; the training loss is not directly comparable to the hard-label baseline.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M2B · Label smoothing
nodes.summary: Test overconfidence separately from the Mixup branch.
changes: No Mixup; otherwise keep M1 settings
nodes.configuration: M1 architecture and recipe; label smoothing epsilon 0.1.
nodes.initialization: Train from scratch; do not load M2A weights.
nodes.notes:
Only the target distribution changes. The example score is slightly higher; more seeds are needed to assess stability.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M2B-ft · Smoothing fine-tune
nodes.summary: Test whether weaker smoothing helps late in training.
changes: Start from the best M2B weights
Reduce epsilon from 0.1 to 0.05; fine-tune for 20 epochs
nodes.notes:
The example changes only slightly. Record the comparison without claiming that less smoothing is always better.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M2B-ft2 · Frozen-BN ablation
nodes.summary: Add a same-day comparison of normalization state updates.
changes: Train 10 epochs with BN running statistics frozen
nodes.configuration: Otherwise match M2B-ft; change only the BN-statistics update rule.
nodes.notes:
No clear gain in the example. Do not include frozen BN in the combined recipe; retain this unsuccessful attempt.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M3 · Combined training recipe
nodes.summary: Combine promising changes and retrain a compact candidate.
changes: 0.75× width plus Mixup and label smoothing
Do not include frozen BN from the previous ablation
nodes.configuration: 90 epochs, batch 64; fixed validation split; low LR in the final stage.
nodes.initialization: Train from scratch. Merge links denote combined methods/settings, not weight averaging.
nodes.notes:
The example recovers some accuracy lost by narrowing. Combined changes still need joint ablations to identify their contributions.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.

nodes.title: M5 · Planned distillation
nodes.summary: Record the next hypothesis; no training results yet.
changes: Use M2A as a frozen teacher
Train a student from scratch with the compact M3 architecture
nodes.configuration: Distillation temperature and loss weight TBD; keep the split and evaluation protocol fixed.
nodes.initialization: Planned: M2A teacher and M3 student architecture; scratch student initialization.
nodes.notes:
This version is planned and has no accuracy or latency measurements. Do not report expected gains as results.
All metrics are illustrative, not real training or hardware results.
